name: Trident Resources Corp.
summary: Trident Resources Corp., headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, focuses on the identification, procurement, assessment, and cultivation of mineral, oil, and natural gas properties across North America. The company's exploratory efforts primarily target deposits of gold, silver, and uranium. A key asset is its complete ownership of the Bell Mountain gold-silver property, which encompasses 174 unpatented lode claims over an area of 1,463 hectares, located southeast of Reno, Nevada. Previously known as Eros Resources Corp., the firm officially adopted the name Trident Resources Corp. in April 2025.
